title: Exodus
attributionNote: Traditional attributions are recorded as tradition, not as settled modern authorship. The book is a composite edited text.
description: The Israelites’ enslavement in Egypt, miraculous redemption, the giving of the Torah, and building of the Mishkan (Tabernacle). The complete Hebrew text and JPS 1917 translation are included in this imported edition.
historicalContext: Part of the Torah division of the Tanakh. Its composition, editing and dating are debated; the catalogue records the text without claiming a single uncontested origin.
